title: Thousands of ayahuasca users report meeting the same all-knowing goddess

tellings.quote: And they take Iawaska and they will meet a goddess down and and you have thousands of reports of people meeting this similar goddess being woman that automatically knows everything that's wrong with you

plain: Thousands of people who drink ayahuasca, a psychedelic brew from the Amazon, report meeting a similar goddess, a female being who instantly knows everything that is wrong with them. The researcher Luke Caverns says this on Michels' show, passing on accounts he has heard. If the reports match, it would suggest people are meeting the same being rather than imagining separate ones.
